A vast volcanic mountain range smoking beneath a blood-red sky, lava glowing in the valleys far below, the jagged peaks marching to a hazy horizon — ample sky for a whole flock.
Towering sea-cliffs plunging into a churning grey ocean, the rock honeycombed with roost-ledges, sea-spray and mist rising in curtains, storm-clouds boiling on the horizon.
A colossal ancient dragon-mountain honeycombed with cave-roosts, smoke and dragon-shapes pouring from its every opening, the immense peak lost in cloud far above.
A stormy sky of boiling thunderheads lit from within by lightning, vast columns of cloud rising to the stratosphere, offering endless aerial corridors and updrafts for a great host.
A blazing sunset sky above an endless patchwork landscape of rivers, forests, and plains stretching to the curved horizon, the air glowing amber and gold.
A frozen peak-range of blue glaciers and wind-scoured ridges under a pale arctic sky, ice-caves glittering in the cliffs, distant auroras shimmering overhead.
A great canyon of soaring rock spires plunging to a shadowed river far below, warm thermals rising between the pillars, countless ledges carved by wind and time.
The skies above a besieged fantasy city ablaze with fire and siege-light, towers and battlements crowded below, smoke and embers rising in vast columns through the night air.
A wide ash-plain strewn with enormous bones, ancient nesting craters pocking the grey earth, a sickly yellow sky overhead, the whole plain stretching horizon to horizon.
A misty valley of towering waterfalls cascading from plateau rims high above, the air thick with vapor and rainbow light, dense canopy far below half-hidden in cloud.
A desert of flat-topped mesas at dawn, long purple shadows stretching across orange sand, the sky brightening from deep violet to pink, the plateaus rising in ascending tiers.
A vast petrified forest of stone-grey trunks wider than towers, the canopy long fallen, the grey sky open above, deep shadow pooling between the enormous trunks far below.
A tempest-lashed open ocean under a black sky, massive waves rolling in endless ranks, lightning illuminating the chaos below, and a long ragged coastline glowing distantly through the rain.
A colossal ruined city reclaimed by jungle, broken towers draped in vines, wide plazas overgrown, the whole decaying expanse stretching far under a hazy tropical sky.
An endless steppe of tall silver grass under a vast overcast sky, a line of dark mountains on the horizon, rivers catching grey light as they wind through the plain.
A sky-island archipelago drifting at high altitude, waterfalls spilling off their edges into open air below, the lower world invisible through cloud, each island offering broad flat roost-space.
A deep primordial swamp of enormous cypress knees and black water, mist clinging to every surface, distant fire-glow from gas vents, the canopy a broken ceiling high above.
A coastal mountain range thrust straight from a dark sea, every cliff-face layered with wind-worn ledges, the water crashing at their roots, a pale moon rising over open water.
A high alpine plateau ringed by higher peaks, a vast cold lake at its center reflecting storm-light, loose boulders and scree fields offering a thousand nesting hollows across its breadth.
A sky of roiling volcanic ash-cloud glowing orange beneath from continent-spanning fires, the ground invisible below, only the tops of the tallest peaks breaking through the burning haze.
A tidal flat of enormous scale revealed at low tide, streaked dark and silver, sea-stacks rising from the wet sand, the retreating ocean glittering to a distant fog-bank.
A range of ancient obsidian mountains, their flanks mirror-black and sharp, reflecting a twin-moonlit sky, deep rifts between them exhaling hot mineral breath into the cold high air.
A colossal river delta seen from altitude, the water splitting into a hundred silver threads across dark earth, the sea beginning far ahead, storm-light slanting across the whole vast expanse.
A chain of dormant crater-calderas forming a highland plateau, each bowl sheltering a steaming lake, the rims wide enough for mass roosting, the surrounding plains extending into distant haze.
A towering polar ice-shelf calving into a black sea far below, the ice-face riddled with blue caverns and ledges, auroras blazing overhead, icebergs drifting away across the dark water.
